text:
deploy-bot: initiating canary for service `embed-service` -> v0.9.1-canaryA. change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. initial traffic 7%. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/backout#embed-service. auto-pin: mem > 85% OR error-rate > 0.7% for 2m -> pin to v0.9.0. rollback cli: `redwoodctl rollback --service embed-service --to v0.9.0`. :rotating_light:

ana: ack, i'll watch memory graphs and heapgrowth. grafana: https://grafana/redwood/embed-service. on pager.

tomas: small question — if we pin, does deploybot swap weights or do we need a proxyctl step?

deploy-bot: deploybot swaps gateway weights on pin. manual proxy fallback: `proxyctl set-route embed-service v0.9.0`. manual pin: `deploybot pin embed-service v0.9.0 --reason "canary fail"`.

ops-lead: runbook checklist i have: 1) open #incident-embed, 2) run rollback, 3) pin, 4) scale down canary pods `kubectl scale deploy/embed-canary --replicas=0`, 5) check shard caches `redis-cli -h shard-01 INFO memory`. link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/backout#embed-checklist :white_check_mark:

ana: metrics to watch: p99 latency, error-rate 5xx, heap growth (RSS), and GC pause spikes. if mem crosses 85% for 2m or errors >=0.8% sustained 2m we rollback immediately.

deploy-bot: canary auto-ramped to 15% at 02:07 UTC. monitoring thresholds active.

tomas: seeing RSS climb on canary nodes starting 02:09, jump from 58% -> 76%. p99 stable for now.

nana: hold — if it keeps climbing we'll roll back. ops-lead is backout lead.

ops-lead: copying rollback commands for quick exec:
```
redwoodctl rollback --service embed-service --to v0.9.0
deploybot pin embed-service v0.9.0 --reason "canary mem spike"
kubectl scale deploy/embed-canary --replicas=0
proxyctl set-route embed-service v0.9.0
infractl pool-update --pool embed-dedicated --model v0.9.0
```

tomas: 02:11 RSS 88% on one canary pod, mem now >85% for 2m. error-rate 0.85%.

nana: ops-lead, authorize rollback?

ops-lead: authorize, execute rollback now.

ops-lead: running `redwoodctl rollback --service embed-service --to v0.9.0` now.

deploy-bot: rollback in progress — 100% complete.

ops-lead: pinned to v0.9.0 and scaled canary down. toggled proxy route as fallback.

tomas: mem dropped back to baseline, error-rate falling. dedicated pool updated by infra.

release-czar: prepping customer note and release page update. ETA ~10m.

nana: adding follow-up: add preflight mem-check for future canaries and add an alert to block auto-ramp if RSS > 70% on first 2 pods. I'll update runbook accordingly.

ops-lead: backout finished at 02:12 UTC. suspected regression: allocator change in v0.9.1 causing memory leak under batching. postmortem assigned to SRE+ML infra.

deploy-bot: canary ended, traffic reverted to v0.9.0. closing thread once postmortem task list is created.
